sents.t: Any strong emotion will release the panda.
sents.zh: 任何强烈的情绪都会把熊猫放出来。

sents.t: Mei-Mei is keeping the panda?
sents.zh: 美美要把熊猫留下来？

sents.t: On the next red moon, you'll undergo a ritual that will seal your red panda spirit into one of these.
sents.zh: 下一个红月亮那天，你要做一个仪式，把你的红熊猫灵封进这样的东西里。

sents.t: And the more you release it, the more difficult the ritual will be.
sents.zh: 你越是把它放出来，仪式就会越难。

sents.t: Mei-Mei, it's one thing to stay calm at home or school, but a concert?
sents.zh: 美美，在家或学校保持冷静是一回事，但去演唱会呢？

sents.t: We need to see this concert.
sents.zh: 我们一定要去看这场演唱会。

sents.t: Yeah, but tickets to 4-Town are, like, a bajillion dollars, and Devon's right here.
sents.zh: 是啊，可 4-Town 的票贵得要命，而且 Devon 就在这儿。

sents.t: Our goal, four tickets. That's 800 bucks!
sents.zh: 我们的目标是四张票。一共八百块！

sents.t: Our family runs one of the oldest temples in Toronto. And the most unique.
sents.zh: 我们家经营着多伦多最古老的寺庙之一，也是最特别的一座。

sents.t: She almost took out half the temple.
sents.zh: 她差点把寺庙拆掉一半。

sents.t: Honor your parents.
sents.zh: 要孝敬父母。

sents.t: Honoring your parents sounds great, but if you take it too far, well, you might forget to honor yourself.
sents.zh: 孝敬父母听起来很好，但如果做过了头，你可能就忘了尊重自己。

sents.t: I'm calm.
sents.zh: 我很冷静。

sents.t: I stayed calm.
sents.zh: 我保持住冷静了。

sents.t: Our ancestors had a mystical connection with red pandas.
sents.zh: 我们的祖先和红熊猫有一种神奇的缘分。

sents.t: The ancestors would be so proud.
sents.zh: 祖先们一定会感到骄傲。

sents.t: I'm just so sick of being perfect.
sents.zh: 我实在受够了要做一个完美的人。

sents.t: My whole life I've been perfect little Mei-Mei.
sents.zh: 我这辈子一直都是她那个完美的小美美。

sents.t: I got so angry, and I lost control.
sents.zh: 我气坏了，然后就失控了。

sents.t: And now you can control it!
sents.zh: 而且现在你可以控制它了！

cards.ex: A panda is a bear-like animal. In this movie, Mei turns into a giant red panda when she gets too excited.
exs: The red panda has a long, fluffy tail.
cards.note: 原句：“Any strong emotion will release the panda.”（任何强烈的情绪都会把熊猫放出来。）

cards.ex: A ritual is a special set of actions people do for a ceremony, often in a traditional or spiritual way.
exs: The family held a ritual on the night of the red moon.
cards.note: 原句：“On the next red moon, you'll undergo a ritual that will seal your red panda spirit into one of these.”（下一个红月亮那天，你要做一个仪式，把你的红熊猫灵封进这样的东西里。）

cards.ex: A concert is a live show where musicians or a band perform for an audience.
exs: They saved money to buy tickets to the concert.
cards.note: 原句：“Mei-Mei, it's one thing to stay calm at home or school, but a concert?”（美美，在家或学校保持冷静是一回事，但去演唱会呢？）

cards.ex: A ticket is a piece of paper or a pass that lets you go into a show, a concert, or a trip.
exs: We need four tickets to get in.
cards.note: 原句：“Yeah, but tickets to 4-Town are, like, a bajillion dollars, and Devon's right here.”（是啊，可 4-Town 的票贵得要命，而且 Devon 就在这儿。）

cards.ex: A temple is a building where people go to honor gods or ancestors, and to pray or hold ceremonies.
exs: Her family takes care of an old temple in the city.
cards.note: 原句：“Our family runs one of the oldest temples in Toronto. And the most unique.”（我们家经营着多伦多最古老的寺庙之一，也是最特别的一座。）

cards.ex: Honor means to show respect to someone, and to treat them as important.
exs: She wants to honor her parents, but also honor herself.
cards.note: 原句：“Honor your parents.”（要孝敬父母。）

cards.ex: Calm means quiet and not excited or angry. If you stay calm, you keep your feelings under control.
exs: Take a deep breath and stay calm.

cards.ex: An ancestor is a family member from a long time ago, like a great-grandparent or someone even earlier.
exs: They honor their ancestors at the temple.
cards.note: 原句：“Our ancestors had a mystical connection with red pandas.”（我们的祖先和红熊猫有一种神奇的缘分。）

cards.ex: Perfect means without any mistakes or flaws. It can also describe someone who feels they must always do everything right.
exs: She was tired of trying to be the perfect daughter.
cards.note: 原句：“I'm just so sick of being perfect.”（我实在受够了要做一个完美的人。）

cards.ex: Control means to keep something in hand, or to stop it from getting too strong. If you lose control, you can no longer hold it back.
exs: She learned how to control the panda.
cards.note: 原句：“I got so angry, and I lost control.”（我气坏了，然后就失控了。）
